facts.fact: The Bureau of Statistics Lesotho publications page lists downloadable Crime Statistics 2022, Education Statistical Report 2023 and Annual Foreign Trade Statistics Report 2024.
The Bureau of Statistics Lesotho page lists a Vital Statistics Report 2022 and Vital Statistics (Births & Deaths) 2021 and 2020.
The Bureau of Statistics Lesotho page lists vital statistics reports of births and deaths for 2020, 2021 and 2022.
